input: Dear team, I'm the executive chef and co-owner of a contemporary Brazilian restaurant in Pinheiros, São Paulo, and we are launching a new pork-focused tasting menu. We need a 6-month supply contract for about 60 kg per week of pork belly and loin: Brazilian pork from Duroc-cross or similar premium genetics, chilled, delivered Tuesday and Friday before 9am, at up to R$48/kg. There must be no boar taint. We want the most tender, juicy pork at chef-level quality, traditional farm-raised pork with real flavour, and zero risk of off-flavour. Please sign with the best supplier. Kind regards

experiences.name: Mantiqueira Specialty Coffee Supply
experiences.description: Single-origin specialty beans from the Serra da Mantiqueira for the restaurant's after-dinner coffee service. Roasted in São Paulo and delivered weekly in 1 kg bags.

experiences.name: Granja Vale Verde — Duroc-Cross Pork Belly & Loin
experiences.description: Farm-raised Duroc pork with chef-grade tenderness, a clean, sweet finish and no off-flavour. Belly and loin from our farm in Minas Gerais, slaughtered and cut in Varginha and vacuum-packed. Males are immunocastrated (two-dose vaccine); no surgical castration. Chilled, by refrigerated truck, Tue/Fri delivery by 8am; 6-month contracts at a fixed price.

experiences.name: Granja Serra Azul — Duroc-Cross Pork Belly & Loin
experiences.description: Traditional farm-raised Duroc pork, a chef favourite for tenderness, with no off-flavour guaranteed. Belly and loin from our farm in Minas Gerais, slaughtered and cut in Poços de Caldas and vacuum-packed. Male piglets surgically castrated in the first week of life without anaesthesia or analgesia. Chilled, by refrigerated truck, Tue/Fri delivery by 8am; 6-month contracts at a fixed price.
experiences.location: Poços de Caldas, Minas Gerais, Brazil

experiences.name: Vale do Ribeira Pupunha & Seasonal Vegetable Supply
experiences.description: Fresh hearts of palm (pupunha) and seasonal vegetables for tasting-menu garnishes and sides. Pupunha from the Vale do Ribeira, delivered Tuesday and Friday.

experiences.name: Fazenda Água Clara — Heritage Duroc × Piau Pork
experiences.description: Traditional farm pork with rich flavour and marbling, raised for chefs. Belly and loin from Duroc × Piau crosses raised in interior São Paulo state and cut in Atibaia. Males are raised entire (not castrated); every carcass is screened for boar taint at slaughter, and positive carcasses are excluded from restaurant supply. Chilled delivery in insulated crates, Tue/Fri by 8am; 6-month contracts at a fixed price.

experiences.name: Sítio Velho — Heritage Duroc × Piau Pork
experiences.description: Old-style farm pork with rich flavour and marbling, the classic choice for chefs. Belly and loin from Duroc × Piau crosses raised in interior São Paulo state and cut in Bragança Paulista. Male piglets surgically castrated at 3–7 days old without anaesthesia or pain relief. Chilled delivery in insulated crates, Tue/Fri by 8am; 6-month contracts at a fixed price.

experiences.name: Farinha do Pará — Artisanal Cassava Flour & Tapioca
experiences.description: Stone-ground artisanal farinha and tapioca for farofa, crusts and Brazilian classics. Made in Pará and delivered monthly in 5 kg sacks.
